mechanism_verified.interpretation: INFERENCE: the official metric (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8) penalises dots that are not near the test faults. Removing catalogue-adjacent dots lowers false-positive weight, but also removes true-positive weight if a new fault lies within 300 m of a removed dot. The +0.0178 user-reported gain over D2.8 (0.2600) is consistent with the first effect; it is not measured here.

radius_ladder_D28.text: Deleting D2.8 dots within r px of the restored catalogue. r = 1 reproduces the H27-4 file; r = 2 reproduces the H33-2-B2 file (GEMSDOE32); r = 1.5 matches neither.

two_px_rule.text: Exactly the D2.8 dots within 2 px of the restored catalogue are deleted; no other dot is removed.
